_comment: Author-written HOLDOUT for the variant-choice and track-baseline fallbacks (issue #352). Same format as variants.json / baselines.json. Written before the fallback's concept lexicon and never used to fit a threshold or a margin: it is a figure to read beside the fitted one. Labels are the author's and have not been reviewed. Not used by any Jev fit (no recordings exist for it).

vlab.title: Machine Learning Research Assistant @ Vision Lab

v_cnn.text: Trained a ResNet-50 on 1.2M images with PyTorch across 4 GPUs, improving top-1 accuracy from 71% to 76%.

v_cnn_syn.text: Fine-tuned a deep residual network on over a million photos using four GPUs, lifting top-1 accuracy by five points.

v_aug.text: Implemented data augmentation pipelines (mixup, random crops) that lifted held-out accuracy by 2 points.

v_poster.text: Presented findings at the department symposium and wrote the lab newsletter.

v_docker.text: Containerised the training code with Docker for reproducible runs on the lab cluster.

m_flink.text: Built a Flink job that aggregates 40k shipment events per second into one-minute windows for the operations dashboard.

m_airflow.text: Orchestrated 14 nightly Airflow DAGs loading the Redshift warehouse, with retries and SLA alerts.

m_airflow_syn.text: Scheduled 14 nightly jobs that load the warehouse, with automatic retries and an alert when the SLA slips.

m_sql.text: Wrote SQL reports of weekly delivery times for the regional managers.

m_wiki.text: Maintained the team wiki and onboarding documents for new interns.

l_api.text: Designed gRPC and REST endpoints for a payments ledger in Go, handling idempotent retries for 2M requests a day.

l_pg.text: Tuned PostgreSQL queries and added indexes, cutting p95 latency from 800 ms to 120 ms.

l_pg_syn.text: Sped up slow database queries by adding indexes, so the 95th-percentile response time fell from 800 ms to 120 ms.

l_tests.text: Raised unit test coverage on the billing service from 41% to 87% with table-driven tests.

l_standup.text: Facilitated daily standups and sprint retrospectives for a team of 6.

o_surv.text: Fit Cox proportional hazards models in R to estimate time to readmission across 3,200 patients.

o_surv_syn.text: Modelled how long 3,200 patients took to return to hospital using hazard models in R.

o_mixed.text: Used mixed-effects models to account for hospital-level clustering in a 14-site study.

o_figs.text: Designed the poster and figures for the lab's annual report.

p_elast.text: Estimated price elasticity for 120 products with log-log regression and presented the results to category managers.

p_tab.text: Built a Tableau dashboard tracking weekly margin by store, used by 9 merchants.

p_tab_syn.text: Created a weekly margin report for each store in Tableau that 9 merchants rely on.

p_ab.text: Ran a price test on 8 stores and reported a 3% margin lift with a confidence interval.

p_cashier.text: Trained new cashiers on the point-of-sale system.

w_vue.text: Built a Vue 3 portfolio site with a responsive CSS grid layout and accessible keyboard navigation.

w_light.text: Raised the Lighthouse performance score from 62 to 96 by lazy-loading images and splitting code.

g_go.text: Taught weekly Go and PostgreSQL workshops to 25 students.

g_grade.text: Graded 90 REST API and microservices assignments.

g_tool.text: Built a Go tool that checks API assignments against a test suite, cutting grading time by 70%.
